content:
sanjay: Quick heads-up — finishing upload for phoenix-1a v1 weights. Need a quick tokenizer sanity pass + final golden prompts before we kick regression. weights at gs://redwood-models/phoenix-1a/v1/weights.tar.gz. @tess @marina please triage.

tess: on it. will run the tokenization smoke and diff against current tokenizer shim. any known nonstandard special tokens?

sanjay: we added two reserved tool tokens: <tool_start> and <tool_end>. tokenizer merged from byte-level base but we kept a custom merge rule for whitespace preservation. also note ctx=4096.

tess: got it. will check for off-by-one around leading spaces. running:

```
python -m redwood.tools.tokenizer_check \ 
  --model-dir gs://redwood-models/phoenix-1a/v1/ \ 
  --test-corpus tests/tokenizer/smoke.txt \ 
  --output /tmp/phoenix-token-check.json
```

marina: I can start regenerating golden prompts after tess confirms tokenization stable. FYI structured output for tool-calls now expects a top-level "tools" array and an optional "diagnostics" object. Example snippet: 

```
{
  "tools": [{"name":"search","args":{"q":"foo"}}],
  "diagnostics": {"token_count": 42}
}
```

oliver: quick config sanity note: our serving config validator will reject if "pad_token" is null. set pad_token explicitly to "" or "[PAD]" in config.yaml. also confirm quantization plan (we recommended q4_0 for initial ramp).

sanjay: will update config to include pad_token: "" and quant: "q4_0". can the validator also check KV cache compatibility flag?

oliver: yes I'll flip on kv_compat check in the linter; will push a small PR.

ci-bot: CI queued: phoenix-1a/tokenizer-smoke (job#4521). Tests: token-diff, prefix-cache, tool-token-preserve.

marina: tokenizer smoke finished — two small mismatches on leading-space handling but preserved <tool_*> tokens. I'll patch the golden prompts to normalize single-leading-space variant and add a dedicated golden for tool-calls.

tess: re-run after marina patch, also throwing in a few structured-output testcases that exercise arrays/objects and unknown-tool behavior.

marina: pushed golden set update: gs://redwood-evals/goldsets/phoenix-1a/v1/golden.tar.gz. Added toolcall/structured cases and a short determinism set.

ci-bot: Regression run started #4522 (goldset: phoenix-1a/v1). Includes: toolcall-smoke, structured-output-schema, e2e-streaming.

sanjay: thanks. one more ask — if regression flags new flaky alerts, please tag me and set severity=low for initial rollout so we can iterate without causing auto-rollbacks.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued -> cluster:dedicated-us-west-2, capacity:small, rollback-policy:manual.

oliver: PR for config linter opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/789 — added pad_token required check and kv_compat toggle.

marina: regression green on structured and toolcall smoke locally; waiting CI confirmation.

ci-bot: Regression #4522 completed: all checks passed.

sanjay: fantastic. proceeding with canary. tagging this thread as last update for onboard handoff. please follow up if anything odd shows up in canary logs (:eyes:).

oliver: quick note for ops — increase prefix-cache TTL from 30s -> 120s for this model during canary to reduce cold-start noise. I'll send the patch to ops channel. :thumbsup:
